svg.title: Verdance — The Great Digital Debate · selected Option A
svg.desc: Full coffee cup mockup using the selected narrower Capitol dome with three sage pixel ribs. Original Verdance wordmark outlines, matching Untitled Serif supporting text, raised yellow sun, six staggered upper columns, four trees and a continuous green column base.

svg.title: Verdance Capitol — Narrower dome, pixel ribs
svg.desc: Every stepped contour, square foliage accent, tree trunk, column, opening and sun block is aligned to one shared unit grid. The baseline is a deliberately smooth thin line. Transparent background. No brown doorway.
